Estimated meal before eating:
- Lasagna or cannelloni piece: about 200 g, roughly 330 kcal.
- Vegetables (carrots, corn, broccoli): about 150 g, roughly 90 kcal.
- Fruit salad: about 130 g, roughly 70 kcal.
- Water: no calories, and I left it out of the food mass.

That comes to about 480 g and 490 kcal served.

After eating, the plates are almost clean. Small traces of sauce and fruit remain, so I estimated about 95% was eaten. That gives roughly 465 kcal and 455 g.
